kharun.name: Kharûn
kharun.short_desc: The scrubstone city. Turns brine into power.
kharun.lore: Built among the only rich scrubstone fields in the region. Its forges and cisterns turn hypersaline water into drinkable supply and sell the means to everyone else. The other cities pay, one way or another.
kharun.notes: Structural monopoly on efficient desalination materials.

zamath.name: Zamath
zamath.short_desc: Western lake city. Forest, salt, and pragmatic deals.
zamath.lore: Closest to the Shore Clans and the night-roaming predators. Holds exclusive access to the only real forest remaining in the region and the craftsmen who produce witching rods. Salt is in the walls and in the blood. They deal with things the rest of the map pretends not to see.
zamath.notes: Only significant timber source. Produces witching rods used in water-finding and desalination work.

thalor.name: Thalor
thalor.short_desc: Northern mountain city. Proud and dependent.
thalor.lore: High passes and thin runoff. Survives on mountain water and carefully rationed scrubstone shipments from the west. Proud, formal, and quietly resentful of its dependence on Kharûn.
thalor.notes: Needs scrubstone and witching rods from the west.

veythar.name: Veythar
veythar.short_desc: Southern mountain city. Isolationist and militant.
veythar.lore: The southern gate. More fortress than city. Isolationist, militant, and deliberately agrarian. Uses its own water sources where possible and buys the rest from Ghorath rather than dealing with Kharûn. Watches the desert and the Stronghold with equal suspicion.
veythar.notes: Tries to stay outside the main political-economic game while remaining viable.

ghorath.name: Ghorath
ghorath.short_desc: The Stronghold. Neutral ground for debts and secrets.
ghorath.lore: An old keep sitting on a stubborn spring. Officially neutral. In practice the place where debts, exiles, spies, and second chances go to live. Seat of the fifth merchant house.
ghorath.notes: Useful broker position between the four cities.

sarns_rest.name: Sarn's Rest
sarns_rest.lore: One of the last places the land still gives water freely. Everyone wants it. No one fully holds it. A natural meeting point for caravans that prefer not to pay city tariffs.
sarns_rest.notes: Strategic freshwater source outside direct city control.

ghul.name: Ghûl
ghul.short_desc: Shore Clan. Takes the larger beasts.
ghul.lore: One of the three Shore Clan settlements. They hunt the bigger brine creatures. The rendering pits never really go cold. The rest of the region buys their products at arm's length.

rukh.name: Rukh
rukh.lore: Most willing of the Shore Clans to trade with outsiders, though still not safe to sleep there. Skilled sailors as well as hunters. They regularly bring freshwater from Sarn's Rest down to Westmark, giving them unusual leverage over water movement in the west.
rukh.notes: Key freshwater logistics link between Sarn's Rest and Westmark.

neth.name: Neth
neth.lore: The most isolated and aggressive of the Shore Clans. Hunters here go out after dark more often than the others. Respected and feared in equal measure.
neth.notes: Highest risk, highest respect among the Clans.

kethra.name: Kethra
kethra.lore: Scrub and thin grain. They quarry the lesser scrubstone and keep their heads down under Kharûn's shadow.

sorel.name: Sorel
sorel.lore: Crossing point and minor salt works. Lives in Zamath's shadow.

draven.name: Draven
draven.lore: Foothill village that watches the passes toward Thalor. Supplies charcoal, rough stone, and news from the northern routes.

moraq.name: Moraq
moraq.lore: Lives off limited lakeside salvage and goat herds. People here prefer not to answer too many questions.

torven.name: Torven
torven.lore: Waystation village that taxes the road and supplies what the high city needs.

ashar.name: Ashar
ashar.short_desc: Last settlement before the deep ridges.
ashar.lore: Easternmost village against the high ridges. Hard people, thin margins, and the final stop before the deep desert.

westmark.name: Westmark
westmark.short_desc: Last stop before Shore Clan water.
westmark.lore: Western lake crossing post. Receives freshwater runs from Rukh out of Sarn's Rest. Last relatively safe stop before Shore Clan territory.

kaleth.name: Kaleth
kaleth.lore: The busiest legitimate exchange point on the map. Sits on the main arteries between Kharûn and the rest of the region.

highmark.name: Highmark
highmark.lore: Northern post under the mountains. Controls approach routes toward Thalor and the high passes.

southmark.name: Southmark
southmark.lore: Southern post in the orbit of the Stronghold. Quiet, well-armed, and priced accordingly.

brineford.name: Brineford
brineford.short_desc: Eastern shore of the central lake.
brineford.lore: Useful for those willing to risk short water hops across the central hypersaline lake. Higher danger, higher potential speed.

ridgewatch.name: Ridgewatch
ridgewatch.lore: Controls the high road toward Ashar and the deep desert. Last major post before the eastern ridges.
